use: The original 1908 gazetteer prints J. Chanfreau’s measured tower, facade statue and vault heights on page 24 and identifies the pale pink rhyolitic quarry stone.
Federal architectural survey describes the octagonal drum, roof vaults, side wings, portals, masonry and facade and tower ornament.
Peabody’s published full facade shows the relationship of the four oculi, central medallion, choir window, clock and lanterns.
